normal.text: Are you here for the streak, not the person?
Are you checking the map on a reflex?
Are you opening this just because the number reminded you?

annoyed.text: Again? Are you keeping a scoreboard, not a friendship?
Are you checking the map like something's going to happen on it?
Are you reading everyone's story when you came for one snap?

brutal.text: Are you keeping a streak with someone you haven't really spoken to in weeks?
Are you guarding this streak harder than your own evening?
brutal.no: No, I've got a real reason

brutal.text: It's still just dots. Are you checking the map anyway?
